author: Joseph Sardin
note: Attribution is not required. Recorded because this project keeps a source list for third-party material. Edited files are the wavs in this folder. Original downloads were not copied into the game.

sources.description: An old Paris metro arrives, stops, then leaves, recorded on the platform.
sources.edit: Roll is the steady close approach from 13.15s to 16.35s with a 120ms loop crossfade. Brake is the high squeal from 21.15s to 23.35s plus two short platform reflections. Start is the motor release and pull-away from 36.20s to 40.80s.

sources.description: A small pneumatic cylinder, recorded indoors.
sources.edit: The same release, slowed slightly so it matches the 0.75-second door travel. Open plays it forward. Close plays it reversed so the air seats at the end of the stroke.
